## Project Goals

We will build and backtest an end-to-end US equity portfolio, covering market data, risk and alpha models, optimization, and accounting.

- Instrument Universe: S&P 500
- Market Data: Yahoo finance/WRDS Security Master data and Databento intraday data
- Risk Model Construction
- Alpha Model Construction: 2-6 alpha models with a 1-day forecast horizon, evaluated with forecast analytics (IC, t-stats, tail statistics)
- Spread Cost Model: estimate the bid-ask spread cost of each trade
- Portfolio Construction: trading 10:00 am - 3:00 pm EST, aiming to trade every 1h
- Accountant: PNL/Sharpe and position

## Data Requirements

- DataBento: 1h bar data from XNAS.ITCH, starting from 2018-05-01 (earliest)
- Yahoo Finance: security master data after 2026-06-30
- WRDS CRSP: security master data before 2026-06-30
- WRDS Global factor model: 153 factors
- Other features: per alpha model request
